name: @ham2k/lib-ham2k-calls
description: Ham2K's callsign records as lookup answers: online from services.ham2k.net, or offline from one of its sets kept on the device
author: Sebastian Delmont <sd@ham2k.com>
//exports: Consumed as TypeScript source: the only consumers are extensions, which
esbuild bundles, so there is no build step and no dist/ to point at.
//peerDependencies: The SDK and the geo library are provided by the extension that consumes
this package: the host carries one copy of each, which the bundle is
rewritten to use at build time.
